confirmed_defect: Runtime.unregister removed actors[id] unconditionally, allowing an old object on_end callback to erase a newer registration for the same entity ID.
reproduction: The real Zoi.SceneZOI on_begin/on_end callbacks register old and replacement objects under the same ID; ending the old object fails the replacement-preservation assertion before the fix.
fix: Remove the registry entry only if its current actor still equals the actor being unregistered. Session participant-unload cleanup remains before this guard.
